title: The couple on the dock
logline: The 1971 wedding photo's couple, old, on Gully's dock in December, in the lawn chair and a folding one beside it, looking at the water where the photo was taken. The photo itself not drawn. Fifty-two years.

panels.composition: An old couple on a dock in December: a woman in the old lawn chair with a blanket, a man in a folding chair beside her, both looking at the bay, the shack behind them with its string lights not yet lit.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an old couple sitting on a wooden dock in December, a woman in an old lawn chair under a blanket and a man in a folding chair beside her, both looking at a gray bay, a shingle shack behind with unlit string lights, no words
image.notes: The 1971 couple from the frame shop (2000). No character ids: strangers.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Fifty-two years. The photo not drawn.
